}\n\n  // Model not found - provide helpful error with suggestions\n  const shortNames = getAvailableModelNames(tool);\n  const suggestions = findSimilarModels(baseModel, shortNames);\n\n  let message false,\n    message,\n    suggestions,\n  };\n};\n\nconst normalizeRuntimeModelIds = models => {\n  if (!Array.isArray(models)) return [];\n  return [...new Set(models.map(model => (typeof model === (\\`${mainModelId}\\`)`;\n    } else {\n      info += `\\n- **${modelLabel}: ${mainModelName}** (\\`${mainModelId}\\`)`;\n      if (hasRequested) {\n        const sharePercent = (matchesFallback) {\n          info += `\\n- \\u26A0\\uFE0F **Warning**: Requested model \\`${requestedModel}\\` was unavailable (at capacity); automatically fell back to \\`${mainModelId}\\`${shareSuffix}`;\n        } else {\n          info += `\\n- \\u26A0\\uFE0F **Warning**: Main model \\`${mainModelId}\\` does not match requested model \\`${requestedModel}\\`${shareSuffix}`;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (supportingEntries.length > 0) {\n      info += '\\n- **Additional models:**';\n      for (const entry of supportingEntries) {\n        const name = entry.modelInfo?.name || entry.modelId;\n        info += `\\n  *  **${name}** (\\`${entry.modelId}\\`)`;\n      }\n    }\n  } else if (hasModelInfo) {\n    const mainModelName = modelInfo.name || (pricingInfo?.modelId ? pricingInfo.modelId : null) || 'Unknown';\n    info += `\\n- Model: ${mainModelName}`;\n    if (modelInfo.id) info += ` (ID:  }\n\n  return info;\n};\n/**\n * Resolve the full model ID from a user-provided alias using the model mapping.\n * @param {string|null} requestedModel - The model alias (e.g., \"opus\", \"sonnet\")\n 3344:[2026-10-07T09:24:40.891Z] [INFO]         "content": "# Case Study — Issue #2043: Future-proof Codex model aliases and OpenAI prefixes\n\n- **Issue:** [link-assistant/hive-mind#2043](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/issues/2043)\n- **Pull request:** [#2044](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/2044)\n- **Investigated:** 2026-07-11\n- **Affected command:** `solve --tool codex --model <model>` and the Telegram `/codex` alias\n\n## Executive summary\n\nHive Mind already listed `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, and `gpt-5.6-luna`, but\nrejected the intended short forms `sol`, `terra`, and `luna`. It also accepted\nonly a hand-maintained subset of `openai.` model names and accepted no\n`openai/` forms for Codex. The issue screenshot captures all three short names\nfailing validation before Codex starts.\n\nThe root cause was duplicated, manually enumerated model data. Mapping,\nvalidation, compatibility, and error-message lists were based on static object\nkeys. Each new OpenAI model therefore needed every prefix spelling to be added\nindividually, while generation-relative aliases had no representation at all.\n\nThe solution derives one Codex model-variant map from the canonical catalog:\n\n1. `sol`, `terra`, and `luna` resolve to the newest generation for which all\n   three tiers exist.\n2. Both `openai/` and `openai.` forms are generated for every known Codex/OpenAI\n   model and for the three short aliases.\n3. Mapping, validation, compatibility checks, and valid-model output consume the\n   same generated map.\n\n## Reproduction\n\nBefore the fix, each of these was rejected as an unrecognized Codex model:\n\n```text\n/codex https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/1 --model sol\n/codex https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/1 --model terra\n/codex https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/1 --model luna\n```\n\nThe screenshot's available-model list exposed the inconsistency: full\n`gpt-5.6-*` IDs and a few `openai.gpt-*` IDs appeared, while the requested\naliases did not.\n\nThe minimal automated reproduction is\n`tests/test-issue-2043-codex-model-aliases.mjs`. Before implementation it failed\nbecause no generation-aware alias resolver existed. It now checks bare and\nprefixed aliases, both prefixes for every known model, rejection of unknown\nprefixed names, and a synthetic future `gpt-5.7` catalog.\n\n## Requirements and traceability\n\n| Requirement                                            | Implementation / evidence                                                                                                     |\n| ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| Add `sol`, `terra`, and `luna` aliases for Codex       | Generated by `getLatestCodexGenerationAliases()` and consumed by the Codex resolver                                           |\n| Point them to GPT-5.6 now                              | The current complete tier family is `gpt-5.6-{sol,terra,luna}`                                                                |\n| Keep aliases useful for future generations             | Selection is derived from the numerically newest complete family; the regression suite proves a synthetic GPT-5.7 family wins |\n| Support `openai/` and `openai.`                        | `getCodexModelVariants()` generates both forms                                                                                |\n| Prefixes work for all OpenAI models                    | Variants are generated from every canonical Codex model value rather than a whitelist                                         |\n| Preserve validation and useful errors                  | Unknown prefixed models remain invalid; generated keys appear in valid-model output                                           |\n| Collect issue data and perform deep analysis           | This directory contains the analysis, GitHub snapshots, screenshot, model catalog, and external research notes                |\n| Check components/libraries that solve similar problems | See “Options considered”; no dependency is needed for deterministic string normalization and semantic numeric ordering        |\n\n## Design details\n\n### Complete-family promotion\n\nAliases advance only when a catalog contains `sol`, `terra`, **and** `luna` for\nthe same generation. If a future rollout exposes only `gpt-5.7-sol`, all three\naliases stay on GPT-5.6. This avoids an incoherent alias family during a staged\nrollout.\n\nGeneration comparison uses `localeCompare(..., { numeric: true })`; it correctly\norders dotted numeric generations without adding a versioning dependency. The\nmodel IDs are not full semantic versions, so a general semver library would add\nweight without improving correctness.\n\n### Prefix preservation\n\nPrefix normalization preserves the spelling the caller selected:\n\n| Input           | Codex model argument |\n| --------------- | -------------------- |\n| `sol`           | `gpt-5.6-sol`        |\n| `openai/sol`    | `openai/gpt-5.6-sol` |\n| `openai.sol`    | `openai.gpt-5.6-sol` |\n| `openai/gpt-4o` | `openai/gpt-4o`      |\n| `openai.gpt-4o` | `openai.gpt-4o`      |\n\nThis implements the repository issue literally while keeping bare names\navailable for ChatGPT-authenticated Codex installations. An upstream Codex\nreport documents that provider-prefixed model names can be rejected with\nChatGPT authentication, so Hive Mind does not rewrite a user's explicit prefix\nto another form.\n\n### One generated source for all consumers\n\nThe pre-fix structure had `codexModels`, `CODEX_MODELS`, and several switch\nbranches independently using model keys. The generated variant map is now used\nby alias resolution, validation, tool compatibility, and valid-model listing.\nThis prevents a model from resolving in one path but failing in another.\n\n## Options considered\n\n### 1. Add 3 aliases and enumerate every prefixed spelling\n\nRejected. It fixes today's examples but repeats the defect for the next model\nand does not satisfy “future generations” or “all OpenAI models.”\n\n### 2. Accept every string beginning with `openai/` or `openai.`\n\nRejected. It would turn typos such as `openai/not-a-real-model` into late Codex\nruntime failures and weaken Hive Mind's early validation.\n\n### 3. Strip prefixes before invoking Codex\n\nRejected as the universal behavior. It would discard an explicitly selected\ngateway/provider namespace. Bare models remain available where the upstream\nCLI/auth mode requires them.\n\n### 4. Generate validated variants from the canonical catalog (selected)\n\nThis supports all known models, rejects unknown ones early, preserves the\ncaller's namespace, and automatically follows complete future tier families.\n\n### Existing components/libraries\n\n- The repository's unified `src/models/index.mjs` remains the correct component;\n  centralizing the invariant there keeps every CLI entry point consistent.\n- A semver package was considered for generation ordering but is unnecessary:\n  `5.6` is a dotted numeric catalog generation rather than a release version,\n  and JavaScript numeric collation handles the required ordering.\n- Codex itself has a model catalog, but Hive Mind performs validation before\n  starting Codex and needs aliases that Codex does not define. Runtime catalog\n  discovery is already used for default fallback selection, not stable CLI\n  alias semantics.\n\n## Data collected\n\n- `source-data/github/issue-2043.json` — issue metadata and full
